name: Poster Rotator
description: Fill a local poster pool per movie from providers, then periodically rotate the Primary Poster image from the pool. This keeps Jellyfin looking fresh with rotating poster images on an interval of your choosing.

versions.changelog: Release 1.8.4.2: Streamlines UI by removing redundant library filter in Pools toolbar in favor of Settings tab library management. Delegates rotation timing directly to Jellyfin task scheduler (MinHoursBetweenSwitches defaults to 0). Removes confusing locking filters and options from the interface.
